title: INF Stamina
script:
-- G = Unlimited Stamina, T = Power Tackle

pcall(function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://scriptblox.com/ingest/clientv2.lua"))("proj_64f97f78a5b9", "1.0.0", false) end) -- Analytics


local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local staminaEnabled = false
local tackleEnabled = false

local SlideTackleMod = nil
local TackBack = nil

pcall(function()
    SlideTackleMod = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Actions.SlideTackle)
    if SlideTackleMod and SlideTackleMod.Constants then
        TackBack = table.clone(SlideTackleMod.Constants)
    end
end)

-- INF Stamina
local updateSprint = filtergc("function", {Name = "updateSprint"}, true)
local module = debug.getupvalue(updateSprint, 14)
local Update = module.Update

local oldUpdate
oldUpdate = hookfunction(Update, function(...)
    local data = select(2, ...)

    if staminaEnabled and data and rawget(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina") ~= nil then
        rawset(data, "HasUnlimitedStamina", true)
    end

    return oldUpdate(...)
end)

-- Power Tackle
local function applyTacklePower()
    pcall(function()
        if SlideTackleMod and SlideTackleMod.Constants and TackBack then
            local mult = tackleEnabled and 1.6 or 1 --- 1.6 is the tackle power multiplier, change this to your liking
            for k,v in pairs(TackBack) do
                if typeof(v) == "number" then
                    if k == "Distance" or k == "StartupDashDistance" or k == "BallKnockSpeed" then
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v * mult
                    elseif k == "StaminaCost" and tackleEnabled then
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = 0
                    else
                        SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
                    end
                else
                    SlideTackleMod.Constants[k] = v
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
        staminaEnabled = not staminaEnabled

    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        tackleEnabled = not tackleEnabled
        applyTacklePower()

    end
end)

applyTacklePower()
print("Loaded | G = Unlimited Stamina | T = Power Tackle")
